_doc: Style library for factory.py. subject is spliced into prompt templates (no speed words: the path sets speed). speed = forward loop speed in m/s (other directions use clips.SPEED_FACTOR unless speed_factor overrides). signature = posture checks every loop must pass (metrics from skeleton.posture: pelvis_h_m, head_h_m, hands_dist_m, hands_h_m, hands_fwd_cm, arm_swing_cm, torso_pitch_deg); 'all' must all pass, at least one of 'any' must pass. Thresholds come from the 2026-10-09 measurements in docs/motion-stage-research/09-experiment-log.md. checks/similarity override factory defaults.

rifle_low_ready.label: RifleLowReady
rifle_low_ready.subject: a man
rifle_low_ready._signature_doc: checks run on the GENERATED (natural) low-ready carry: grip hand at chest/belly, support hand lower/forward/left, little swing, upright; the collapse is applied afterwards by carry_edit
rifle_low_ready.prompt_idle: a man stands still looking straight ahead, holding a rifle in a low ready position with the muzzle pointed down
rifle_low_ready.prompt_loop: a man walks {dir} holding a rifle in a low ready position with the muzzle pointed down
rifle_low_ready.prompt_start: a man is standing still holding a rifle in a low ready position with the muzzle pointed down, then starts walking {dir}
rifle_low_ready.prompt_stop: a man walks {dir} holding a rifle in a low ready position with the muzzle pointed down, then stops and stands still
rifle_low_ready.prompt_turn: a man holding a rifle in a low ready position with the muzzle pointed down stands still and then turns {amount} to his {side}

hand_anchor._doc: Kimodo's own low-ready carry (screening wording 0, seed 2, frame 51, upright); pinning it keeps the carry identical across clips without fighting the model

carry_edit._doc: collapse the carry at export with arm IK: grip hand -18 cm (belt height), support hand -9 cm (hip/thigh); spine and legs untouched

idle_signature._doc: head up (walk loop head is 1.54 m), stance up to about shoulder width (36 cm measured), upright
